{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are too slow to react to sentiment changes, showing lag of 1-2 days after positive/negative sentiment shifts",
    "When sentiment turns negative, model forecasts remain elevated longer than actual prices correct",
    "Sentiment values of 1.0 (strong buy) require faster price acceleration than model predicts",
    "Model mean-reversion is excessive when sentiment is strongly bullish, missing genuine price momentum",
    "Prices exhibit more persistence in sentiment than model assumes, causing forecast divergence",
    "Model under-responds to consecutive days of matching sentiment, creating forecast lag",
    "When sentiment oscillates, model fails to capture the momentum shifts in actual prices"
] }
